title: British Feet Grew As Adult Bodies Spread Them Wider
hook: British feet grew longer, wider, and body size helps explain why.
closing: Your shoes are not shrinking; adult feet can change enough to need a new size.
question: Has your shoe size changed?

segments.say: Average British men's shoes reached size 10, two sizes larger than in the seventies.
About 67 percent of women report wider adult feet, showing the change is not only length.
About 66 percent of adults in England carry excess weight, which can spread the foot.
